Seller.title: Seller
Seller.description: Represents an individual seller of collectible cards.

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: Records an individual transaction for a collectible card.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Sale entity.

cardName.description: The name of the collectible card sold.

price.description: The sale price of the card, in the local currency (e.g., GBP).

saleDate.description: The date when the sale was recorded, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

sellerId.description: Reference to the Seller who made this sale. (Relationship: Seller 1:N Sale)
